results.title: Housing Society Can Fix Maintenance, But Must Pass On BMC Property Tax Concession: Court
results.description: Mumbai Co-op Court says societies can fix maintenance but must apply BMC property-tax concessions to eligible individual tenements. The post Housing Society Can Fix Maintenance, But Must Pass On BMC Property Tax Concession: Court appeared first on Square Feat India .

results.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate Closes Its Three-Year Story With Rat King as Final Boss
results.description: TMNT: Splintered Fate's free King's Gambit update closes the roguelike brawler's main campaign with the Rat King as a new endgame final boss harder than Shredder, three years after the game's Apple Arcade debut. The update also introduces Slash as paid DLC and transitions the Gold Edition to a new Platinum bundle.
